name: aps-skills
description: Agent skills for Autodesk Platform Services (APS) and Autodesk products like AutoCAD and Flow Production Tracking.

plugins.name: acad-arx-wizard
plugins.description: Scaffold ObjectARX C++ projects/classes for AutoCAD 2027 and Visual Studio 2026 using deterministic PowerShell generators (ARX/DBX/CRX, Jig, Reactors, Custom Object, MFC, .NET, COM, DynProp).

plugins.name: acad-cuix-builder
plugins.description: Generate AutoCAD partial CUIX files from prompts. Describe your ribbon panels and LISP/command buttons conversationally and get a ready-to-CUILOAD .cuix with embedded BMP icons.

plugins.name: acad-dotnet
plugins.description: Scaffold and develop AutoCAD 2027 .NET plugins (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Plant 3D) targeting .NET 10 / x64. Covers csproj patterns, bundle packaging, desktop testing, and Design Automation deployment.

plugins.name: aps-docs-portal
plugins.description: Navigate the APS documentation portal — decode glossary terms, crawl TOC JSON trees, extract content from static HTML pages, and convert CDN URLs to clickable portal links.

plugins.name: aps-mcp-server-gen
plugins.description: Scaffold a custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that integrates with APS. Supports Node.js/TypeScript, .NET/C#, and Python.

plugins.name: flow-ptr-app
plugins.description: Guide for developing Flow Production Tracking (FPTR) / ShotGrid Toolkit apps following a spec-driven lifecycle — capture intent, write and validate a spec, plan, implement, verify, release, and maintain.
